title: Innokin Endura Apex Vape Kit
description: Innokin are back with the Endura Apex, the latest in the legendary Endura series of pen-style vapes and a kit that offers an incredible vaping experience in a simple-to-use and elegant device. Boasting a classic cylindrical, all-in-one vape kit design with a smooth satin finish, the Innokin Endura is light and comfortable to hold and is available in six stunning colours to suit your personal style. With an integrated 1800mAh battery , the Innokin Endura Apex can easily last most moderate vapers a full day of use, while USB Type-C charging ensures that when it is time to recharge the device, you can see a full a charge in approx. 40 minutes. The Innokin Endura Apex is operated by via a single, tactile fire button which turns the device on and off with five clicks. An innovative dial at the base of the Endura Apex allows you to choose between two different power levels displayed by an illuminated LED band. ‘Green’ provides a cool and stealthy vape, while ‘Red’ delivers a more intense vape. The Innokin Endura Apex tank has an e-liquid capacity of 2ml and is easy to refill by detaching the mouthpiece to reveal the fill port. By turning the tank at the base you can easily adjust the airflow for a loose and airy or tight and intense draw. The Endura Apex tank is compatible with Innokin’s next-generation T20S coils which are all built for incredible flavour and vapour production. The included 0.9ohm Prism S Coil is ideal for an intense and flavoursome MTL (mouth-to-lung) experience ideal for the Endura Apex’s ‘Green’ power setting, while the 0.8ohm Prism S Coil provides a slightly looser RDTL (restricted direct-to-lung) sensation with the Endura Apex’s ‘Red’ power setting. Both coils work best with 50/50, nic salts or high-PG e-liquids Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
